def update(self, req, node_id, body):
    node_data = body.get('node')
    if node_data is None:
        raise exc.HTTPBadRequest(_("Malformed request data, missing" 'node' key in request body."))

    data = NodeData(node_data)
    if not data.name() or not data.profile_id():
        raise exc.HTTPBadRequest(_("Node name and profile ID must be provided."))

    self.rpc_client.node_update(req.context, node_id, data.name(),
                                data.profile_id(),
                                data.role(), data.tags())

    raise exc.HTTPAccepted()
